domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
x ranges over all real numbers
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n greater than 1, the function En has period 1 with respect to integer shifts: for all real x and all integers m, En(x plus m) equals En(x).
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses: the statement is purely universal

statement_nl: For every integer n>1, every real number x, and every integer m, one has E_n(x + m) = E_n(x).
